task: 1. Identify the student(s) who appear most frequently in the score.xlsx file and count the number of times each name appears. 2. Create a summary report in report.docx listing the name(s) with the highest number of appearances and their corresponding count(s). 3. Convert the report.docx file into report.pdf. Ensure the word report includes the main result and the context of the task.
query_sentence: Summarize which student name appears most frequently in the score file and generate a report docx and pdf.

ground_truth_memory.item: The summary report should be saved as report.docx in the data directory.
After creating report.docx, convert it to report.pdf in the same directory.
The summary must state which student name(s) appears most often in the score.xlsx file and the number of appearances.
When listing the top name(s), include both the name(s) and how many times they appear.
Make sure the report includes context that this is based on the analysis of score.xlsx and the frequency of names.
